title: Patch: a card-statistics request for a patch the server does not ship reads only that patch
thread:
**Issue #3067 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3067: Patch: a card-statistics request for a patch the server does not ship reads only that patch
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The public card-statistics page can be asked for any patch name. Asking for one that doesn't exist makes the server read every game total of every patch from the database and work out the whole report again. It does this on every such request and never keeps the answer. A script that loops over made-up patch names can trigger this hundreds of times a minute, without signing in, on the small server that also runs every live match. Once this is built, a made-up patch costs one small read, the real patches share one big read per cache window, and the page shows the same numbers.

## Why

- `crates/server/src/api/stats.rs:959`: `requested_patch = query_trimmed(&req, "patch").unwrap_or(current_patch)` takes any string and passes it to `kept_window` (:972). `/api/stats/games` does the same (:1234-1241).
- `stats.rs:757-767`: `kept_window` loads with `patch: None`, which reads every row of the record, game and card totals.
- `stats.rs:794-797`: `if !known { return compute().await; }`. An unknown patch is computed on every request and never kept (R978000).
- An unknown patch's window is that patch alone (`crates/engine/src/wire/stats/window.rs:130-141`, `resolve`), so the full load is wasted. `kept_report` already loads a single patch (`stats.rs:873`).
- The only bound is the per-address rate limit. The kept cache's 256 slots (`CARD_STATS_KEPT_REPORTS`, `crates/server/src/config.rs:964`) are fewer than its keys, so rotating through real keys misses as well.

## Proposal

- For a patch the server does not ship, load only that patch's totals, and take the patch-list fields (`patches`, `history`, `live_games`) from the kept current-patch window.
- Keep one all-patch totals snapshot per `CARD_STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`, loaded once however many misses arrive together. Every `kept_window` and `kept_history` miss reads from it.
- A ruling note amending R978000 and R1367000: no figure changes, only the reads.

## Where it lands

- `crates/server/src/api/stats.rs` and `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs`.
- `crates/server/README.md`.
- §9.11, `spec/rulings/` and `spec/pending/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With the existing load counters (`tests/api/stats.rs:1270-1296`), ten requests for distinct unknown patches cost no full load.
- [ ] Thirty requests over distinct known keys within one TTL cost one full load.
- [ ] Every response body is byte-identical to today's for the same totals (R654).
- [ ] `r978000_a_patch_the_server_does_not_ship_is_never_kept` stays green. The load counts pinned by R2491000's tests change only with that ruling amended.

## Size and risks

Medium, server only: about 3 files and 200 lines. The figures must stay byte for byte the same, so the tests compare whole bodies. One snapshot is held in memory for the length of the cache window.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

1. **`stats.rs`, types.** Beside `KeptWindowCell`, add `type KeptTotalsCell = Arc<OnceCell<Arc<StatsTotals>>>;` and:

   /// R3067000: every patch's totals, and when its cell was first asked for.
   struct KeptTotals { made_at: i64, totals: Arc<StatsTotals> }
   ```
2. **`KeptReports`.** Add the field `totals: Mutex<Option<(i64, KeptTotalsCell)>>`, with a doc line citing R3067000. Add `fn totals_cell(&self, now: i64) -> (i64, KeptTotalsCell)`, copied from `play_rates_cell`:

3. **`kept_snapshot`.** Next to `totals_for`, add:
   ```rust
   async fn kept_snapshot(app: &App) -> Result<KeptTotals, ApiError>
   ```

   fn window_over(totals: &StatsTotals, history: &[PatchStep], at: &str, source: SourceParam, pilot: PublicStatsPilot, mode: PublicStatsMode) -> KeptWindow
   ```

5. **`shipped_window`.** Add `async fn shipped_window(app, history, at, source, pilot, mode) -> Result<Arc<KeptWindow>, ApiError>`:

   - Build the same `ReportKey` as today.
   - `let cell = app.card_stats.window_cell(key, snapshot.made_at);`. Pass `snapshot.made_at`, **not** `now_ms()`: a window then expires with its snapshot, so no figure is older than one TTL.
   - `cell.get_or_try_init(|| async { Ok::<_, ApiError>(Arc::new(window_over(&snapshot.totals, history, at, source, pilot, mode))) }).await?`, then return `Arc::clone`.
6. **`kept_window`.** Keep the signature. Replace the body:
   ```rust
   let known = at == app.catalog.version || history.iter().any(|step| step.version == at);
   if known { return shipped_window(app, history, at, source, pilot, mode).await; }
   // R3067000: an unshipped patch's window is that patch alone (engine `resolve`).
   let shared = shipped_window(app, history, &app.catalog.version, SourceParam::Default,
       PublicStatsPilot::Merged, PublicStatsMode::All).await?;
   let own = totals_for(app, Some(at), false).await?;

   window.patches = shared.patches.clone();

   ```

9. **`fake.rs`, `stats_totals_load`.** After `call(f, "statsTotals.load")?;` add:

       call(f, "statsTotals.loadAllPatches")?; // R3067000: counted apart from one patch's load
   }
   ```
10. **Tests.** Edit `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs` as set out under Tests.
11. **Spec files.**
    - `spec/rulings/R3067000.md`. Front matter:

All in `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs`. The new tests go inside `mod r2491000_kept_card_history` so they reuse `game`, `Db` and `StoreError`. Add `use std::time::Duration;` there.

- Replace `count_loads` with a counter pair. Add `#[derive(Default)] struct Loads { all: AtomicUsize, full: AtomicUsize }`.

1. `r978000_card_stats_are_kept_for_the_ttl_then_computed_again` (:1144). The `?pilot=human` assertion becomes `json!(1)`. Comment: "R3067000: another pilot's report is cut from the snapshot the first read loaded." After the final TTL assertions, add a `?pilot=human` request and assert `totalGames == 2`.
2. `r2491000_a_drill_down_reads_its_patch_history_in_one_load_kept_per_match_type` (:1314). The four first-view loads become `[2, 1, 1, 1]`. The first loads the snapshot and the current drills. **New tests** (`#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]`):
- `r3067000_distinct_known_keys_within_one_ttl_cost_one_load_of_every_patch`:
  - Seed a few records on the current patch and a past one, via `game`.
  - Request `/api/stats/cards?source={all,live,dev}&pilot={merged,human,ai}&mode={all,bo1,bo3,random,constructed}` (45 keys, assert `>= 30`), a few with `&patch=<past shipped>`, and `/api/stats/games?source=…&mode=…`.
  - The first request's `reads_of` is `(1, 1)`. Every later one is `(0, 0)`.
  - Byte identity: for three keys, a fresh `test_app()` seeded with the same records answers a body equal to the shared app's (`assert_eq!` on the whole `Value`).
  - `advance(TTL - 1 ms)` then one request: `(0, 0)`. `advance(1 ms)` then one more: `(1, 1)`.
- `r3067000_distinct_unshipped_patches_cost_no_load_of_every_patch`:
  - Seed one live game on each of 10 made-up patches (`v0.0.0-made-up-{i}`) and one on the current patch.
  - Cold app: the first made-up request is `(2, 1)`: the snapshot behind the shared window, plus its own load. The other nine are `(1, 0)` each.
  - Then `/api/stats/cards` (default key, already kept) is `(0, 0)`.
  - Each made-up body has `patch`, `totalGames == 1` and `summary.activePatch` right.
  - Insert a second record on made-up patch 0 and request it again: `totalGames == 2` (never kept).
- `r3067000_an_unshipped_patch_answers_what_its_own_records_give`:
  - App A holds records on the current patch, a past patch, and `v0.0.0-not-shipped` (3 live games).
  - App B holds only the 3 `v0.0.0-not-shipped` games.
  - Request `?patch=v0.0.0-not-shipped` on both. After removing `"patches"` from each body, the bodies are equal. A's `patches` equals A's default `/api/stats/cards` `patches`.
  - Repeat the pair for `/api/stats/games?patch=…`, whole bodies equal.

**Must stay green:** `r978000_a_patch_the_server_does_not_ship_is_never_kept` unchanged, `r978000_card_drill_downs_share_the_kept_reports_across_cards`, the second R2491000 test, the `r1044000_…` and `r1994000_…` tests.

- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`

## Done when

- [ ] Ten distinct unshipped patches cost no all-patch load once the snapshot is kept (test 2).
- [ ] Thirty or more distinct known keys within one TTL cost one all-patch load (test 1).
- [ ] Whole bodies match the reference apps (tests 1 and 3, R654).
- [ ] `r978000_a_patch_the_server_does_not_ship_is_never_kept` is green. The only changed pins are the two amendments above, and R3067000 amends R2491000.
- [ ] R3067000, `spec/pending/3067.md`, the three "Amended by" paragraphs, §9.11 and the README are edited.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` (workspace), `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check` pass. A change to `apps/web/src/wire` would be a bug.

## Risks

- **Staleness.** Window and history cells carry the snapshot's `made_at`, so no figure outlives one TTL. If the builder passes `now_ms()` instead, ages can reach two TTLs and §9.11's "up to the TTL" breaks.
- **Test pins.** Anything else that inserts records between stats requests on a different key within a TTL now reads the snapshot. The only such tests found are the two amended; grep `insert_records` plus a second key if another turns red.
- **Memory.** One `StatsTotals` (no drills) is held per TTL, as the issue accepts. Windows and histories stay under `CARD_STATS_KEPT_REPORTS`.
- **Async.** Do not recurse through `kept_window`. No lock is held across an `.await`: `totals_cell` and `kept_cell` return before awaiting.
- **Fake hook.** The extra `loadAllPatches` charge only matters to tests whose `on_call` hooks look at that method. A grep found none outside `stats.rs`.
- **Unshipped `at == catalog.version` but absent from `patches.json`:** this is the known path, as before. Its figures come from the snapshot and are unchanged.

## Open questions

None. Decisions the issue left open:
- Window and history cells carry the snapshot's `made_at`. Rejected: their own clock.
- `live_games` comes from the unshipped patch's own load. Rejected: the current window's.
- The default current-patch key is the shared window.
- The test split uses a new fake method name, `statsTotals.loadAllPatches`. Rejected: guessing from counts.
````

## Risks

- **Staleness.** Window and history cells carry the snapshot's `made_at`, so no figure outlives one TTL. If the builder passes `now_ms()` instead, ages can reach two TTLs and §9.11's "up to the TTL" breaks.
- **Test pins.** Anything else that inserts records between stats requests on a different key within a TTL now reads the snapshot. The only such tests found are the two amended; grep `insert_records` plus a second key if another turns red.
- **Memory.** One `StatsTotals` (no drills) is held per TTL, as the issue accepts. Windows and histories stay under `CARD_STATS_KEPT_REPORTS`.
- **Async.** Do not recurse through `kept_window`. No lock is held across an `.await`: `totals_cell` and `kept_cell` return before awaiting.
- **Fake hook.** The extra `loadAllPatches` charge only matters to tests whose `on_call` hooks look at that method. A grep found none outside `stats.rs`.
- **Unshipped `at == catalog.version` but absent from `patches.json`:** this is the known path, as before. Its figures come from the snapshot and are unchanged.

## Goal

An unshipped `?patch=` costs one small read, and every real key shares one big read per cache window. The page's numbers don't change.

- [ ] R3067000, `spec/pending/3067.md`, the three "Amended by" paragraphs, §9.11 and the README are edited.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` (workspace), `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check` pass. A change to `apps/web/src/wire` would be a bug.

## Risks

- **Staleness.** Window and history cells carry the snapshot's `made_at`, so no figure outlives one TTL. If the builder passes `now_ms()` instead, ages can reach two TTLs and §9.11's "up to the TTL" breaks.
- **Test pins.** Anything else that inserts records between stats requests on a different key within a TTL now reads the snapshot. The only such tests found are the two amended; grep `insert_records` plus a second key if another turns red.
- **Memory.** One `StatsTotals` (no drills) is held per TTL, as the issue accepts. Windows and histories stay under `CARD_STATS_KEPT_REPORTS`.
- **Async.** Do not recurse through `kept_window`. No lock is held across an `.await`: `totals_cell` and `kept_cell` return before awaiting.
- **Fake hook.** The extra `loadAllPatches` charge only matters to tests whose `on_call` hooks look at that method. A grep found none outside `stats.rs`.
- **Unshipped `at == catalog.version` but absent from `patches.json`:** this is the known path, as before. Its figures come from the snapshot and are unchanged.

## Open questions

None. Decisions the issue left open:
- Window and history cells carry the snapshot's `made_at`. Rejected: their own clock.
- `live_games` comes from the unshipped patch's own load. Rejected: the current window's.
- The default current-patch key is the shared window.
- The test split uses a new fake method name, `statsTotals.loadAllPatches`. Rejected: guessing from counts.
